text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government sets up task force to map out a new strategy for the debt-ridden state-owned Malta Drydocks.

- Foreign Minister George Vella meets European Union foreign ministers in Brussels saying Malta would no longer press its 1990 application to join the EU but would seek closer relations with the bloc.
- Malta's current account deficit dropped by 19.8 million Maltese lira ($55.5 million) to reach 16.6 million Maltese lira in the second quarter of 1996.
- Air Malta to inaugurate service to Djerba, Tunisia.
